description: MUMmer 3.23 nucmer, the whole pipeline: prenuc (the reference records joined with an x after each) | mummer (anchors: matchMode 'mum' = unique in reference and query, 'mumreference' = unique in the reference (default), 'maxmatch' = all; minMatch = -l; only A/C/G/T match; both strands unless forwardOnly / reverseOnly) | mgaps (clusters: maxGap = -g, minCluster = -c, diagonalDifference = -D, diagonalFactor = -d) | postnuc (the banded Smith-Waterman extension of the clusters: gaps between the matches of a cluster, then outward off both ends until the score has not improved for breakLength = -b bases; clusters that meet fuse; with simplify (default) clusters shadowed by an earlier alignment are dropped; extend / optimize / banded as --[no]extend / --[no]optimize (nooptimize forces the extension to the sequence ends) / --banded (hard diagonal band = diagonalDifference)). Returns the text of the .delta file - the alignments between every reference record and every query record as the distances between insertions and deletions (first line = the two file names, then NUCMER, then per record pair '>refId qryId refLen qryLen' and per alignment 'sR eR sQ eQ errors simErrors nonAlpha' followed by the delta values and 0; a reverse-strand alignment has sQ > eQ) - byte for byte what the installed nucmer 3.23 writes (434 runs: multi-record inputs, both strands, repeats, N runs, every option family, the abort paths). With delta = false (--nodelta) the .cluster text is returned instead; coords (-o) adds the coords file (show-coords -r of the delta). The prefix (-p) names files and has no meaning here. A break length outside 1 - 10000 is ignored with a warning (messages), as the program does. The inputs on which the programs abort (empty file, no header, a file whose only record is empty, an unparsable header) are refused with an error.

minMatch.description: Minimum length of a single match (-l, default 20).

maxGap.description: Maximum gap between two adjacent matches of a cluster (-g, default 90).

minCluster.description: Minimum length of a cluster of matches (-c, default 65).

diagonalDifference.description: Maximum diagonal difference of two adjacent anchors (-D, default 5).

diagonalFactor.description: Diagonal difference as a fraction of the gap length (-d, default 0.12).

breakLength.description: Distance an extension tries to extend poor scoring regions before giving up (-b, default 200; outside 1 - 10000 ignored with a warning).

banded.description: Enforce absolute banding of the dynamic programming matrix with diagonalDifference (--banded, default false).

forwardOnly.description: Use only the forward strand of the query (-f, default false).

reverseOnly.description: Use only the reverse complement of the query (-r, default false); both flags = both strands.

delta.description: Create the delta (--delta, default true); false returns the cluster file (--nodelta).

optimize.description: Alignment score optimisation (--optimize, default true); false = --nooptimize: an extension that reaches the end of a sequence is not backtracked.

simplify.description: Remove shadowed alignments (--simplify, default true); false = --nosimplify (align a sequence to itself to find repeats).

referenceName.description: Reference file name printed in the first line of the output (nucmer prints the absolute path).

queryName.description: Query file name printed in the first line of the output.

coords.description: Also return the NUCmer 1.1 coords file (-o / --coords: show-coords -r of the delta; default false; not with delta = false).

delta.description: Text of the .delta file (null with delta = false).

cluster.description: Text of the .cluster file (only with delta = false).

messages.description: What the programs write to standard error (warnings).

coords.description: Text of the coords file (only with coords = true).

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
mummer: empty sequence in multiple fasta file (and the other aborts of the programs)
